journey.name: TL-18 Deleting the only match shows the no-matches copy, not the empty state
journey.description:
The boundary between the two sentences REQUIREMENTS.md section 9 keeps apart. isEmpty is tasks.isEmpty(); hasNoMatches is tasks.isNotEmpty() with nothing left after the filter. Deleting the last row a query matches lands exactly on the second one - three tasks still exist, none of them visible - and the wrong branch here would tell the user their board is empty and offer them a plus button instead of a query to clear.
ST-06 reaches hasNoMatches by typing a query that matches nothing. This reaches it by taking the match away, which is the path where tasks and visibleTasks disagree because of a write rather than because of the field.
The undo at the end is the return trip: the query is still "dentist", the restored task still matches it, and the row has to reappear inside the filter that was live the whole time.
The soft keyboard sits over the snackbar after typing, so dismiss it before touching Undo - see qa/README.md, "Two things that will waste a run if you miss them".
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

Verify that the no-matches message is no longer on screen
Verify that the "Search by title" field still contains "dentist"
